description:
# Check-completion gate for epic opi-q5k

Close this ticket when every per-file check ticket under epic opi-q5k has been processed (closed). Each check ticket either (a) confirms our Elixir tests already match upstream, or (b) spawned a compliance ticket that blocks the acceptance gate.

This gate does NOT wait for compliance tickets to be resolved — only for the checks themselves to be done.

# How to verify

- \`bw list --parent opi-q5k --all\` — every check ticket (titled "Check: upstream <file>") is closed.
- The acceptance gate remains blocked by any open compliance tickets.

# On close

Acceptance gate (see its blocked-by list) becomes eligible once no other blockers remain.

# Check-completion gate closed

All 21 per-file check tickets processed. Summary:

- opi-q5k.23 — wrap-ansi.test.ts: 100% upstream behaviors covered; no gaps
- opi-q5k.4 — bug-regression-isimageline: behaviors folded into opi-q5k.34 compliance (terminal-image.test.ts)

- opi-q5k.24 — fuzzy exact-match score assertion
- opi-q5k.25 — keybindings no-evict-defaults invariants
- opi-q5k.26 — overlay short-content integration test

- opi-q5k.31 — WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width implementation + 8 tests

- opi-q5k.33 — SelectList upgrade to {value,label,description} + 5 tests

- opi-q5k.38 — input CJK overflow sweeps (2 invariant tests)
- opi-q5k.39 — Autocomplete file-path provider (major subsystem, 32 tests)
- opi-q5k.41 — keys matchesKey function + Windows Terminal 0x08 + decoder tests

Master compliance tickets with per-describe children:
- opi-q5k.40 — editor.test.ts master (13 children: prompt history, public accessors, Kitty, Unicode editing, grapheme wrap, word wrap, kill ring, undo, autocomplete integration, character jump, sticky column, paste atomicity, backslash+Enter divergence doc)
- opi-q5k.42 — markdown.test.ts master (13 children: tables, nested lists, heading+code, thinking traces, spacing × 4, blockquotes multiline, strikethrough, HTML tags, links, combined)

## Statistics
- Upstream tests audited: ~800+ across 21 files
- Direct compliance tickets: 17
- Sub-children under master compliance: 26 (editor 13 + markdown 13)
- Acceptance gate (opi-q5k.1) blocked by: 19 direct compliance deps + both master epics

## Next
Processing agents can now work compliance tickets via `bw ready` under opi-q5k. Once all compliance is closed, opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate) unblocks.
